title: PGSimCity - How PostgreSQL Works
summary: PGSimCity is an interactive visual simulation that explains how PostgreSQL works internally, using a city-building game metaphor to make complex database concepts like query processing, buffer management, and concurrency control accessible and engaging.
problem_solved: Makes the complex and abstract internals of PostgreSQL understandable through interactive gamification.
why_valuable: Provides an intuitive, visual way to learn database internals that are typically hidden and difficult to grasp, helping developers become better at optimizing queries and understanding system behavior.
